title: Her horoscope and Buddy's death
summary: She says she watches her horoscope daily, more since Buddy died five years ago.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, Buddy wouldn't let me go. (Unintelligible) but not since Buddy's dead. Buddy's been dead five years now. So now, if everybody's going to go, I don't mind going. (Unintelligible).
Yeah, right. How did you know?
Have you been -- you been watching your horoscope all your life?

Yeah, I watched it all my life. (Unintelligible) really watch it. Since Buddy's been dead, I'm really watching it. I didn't watch it until he died. Sitting here by myself, I do watch it. Now, everyday, I read the horoscopes. (Unintelligible). But I read it everyday. Everyday.
